# data-visualisation-26478FE2

**MUST_NOT:** Do not use chart scales that misrepresent differences between data points.

## Rationale

Inaccurate scale gives an incorrect impression of the original data.

## Sources

- **https://www.nngroup.com/articles/designing-effective-infographics/**
  - weight: 0.7
  - sourced: fetched
  > When the scale of a chart does not accurately represent differences between data points then it gives an incorrect impression of the original data.
